summary: Rich Sorro Commons is a 100-unit affordable housing building at 150 Berry St in Mission Bay, developed by Mission Housing Development Corporation for families and people living with HIV/AIDS. Mission Housing's own project page states it opened in July 2002, the first affordable family housing development in Mission Bay.

milestones.text: SF Dept. of Building Inspection permit #200004187592 filed to erect a 5-story, 100-unit residential building at 150 Berry St
Rich Sorro Commons opened -- the first affordable family housing development in Mission Bay.

open_questions: DataSF Assessor's own year_property_built field records 2003, one year after Mission Housing's stated July 2002 opening -- likely reflects the tax roll's assessment lag rather than a different construction date; not further reconciled here.

The 2000 construction permit's own block/lot (block 3795B, lot 001, an older pre-redevelopment block grid) differs from the Assessor's current blklot 8706264; the address, 100-unit/5-story description, and October 2002 permit-completion date (matching Mission Housing's July 2002 opening and the Assessor's 2003 year, both within months) line up with this parcel, so this is treated as Mission Bay's redevelopment-era block renumbering, not a different building.
